prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 – Summary (under 500 words)

Core offer: A “Fair Deal” built on five themes – a stronger, greener economy; reliable public services; a protected natural environment; an open, internationalist UK; and a truly fair democracy.

Economy and business
- Responsible finances and stability, with OBR oversight; fix EU trading relationship; UN SDGs focus.
- Green-led growth: major investment in renewables, home insulation and grid/storage; 90% renewable electricity by 2030; net zero by 2045.
- Skills and work: Lifelong Skills Grants (£5,000), more apprenticeships, replace apprenticeship levy with a flexible skills levy, overhaul sick pay, day-one parental rights, expanded flexible working.
- Small firms: abolish business rates and replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; late payment clampdown; local banking; AI regulation that enables innovation and safeguards rights.
- Tax: reverse bank tax cuts; one-off proper windfall tax on oil/gas; raise Digital Services Tax to 6%; fair CGT reform; 4% levy on large share buybacks; priority for future income tax cuts via higher personal allowance.

Public services: health, care, education
- NHS: legal right to a GP appointment in 7 days/24h if urgent; recruit 8,000 more GPs; fix NHS dentistry; mental health hubs in every community and a professional in every school; 100% cancer treatment within 62 days; ambulance/hospital investment; modern IT; drug policy health-led with a legal, regulated cannabis market.
- Social care: free personal care; workforce plan, Royal College of Care Workers and a £2/hour Carer’s Minimum Wage; paid carers’ leave and guaranteed respite; cross-party funding deal; National Care Agency.
- Education: per-pupil funding rises; repair unsafe buildings; tutoring guarantee for disadvantaged pupils; early years boost (extra free hours, tripled EYPP); reinstate university maintenance grants; SEND national body; teacher pay/body independence; curriculum and assessment reform; Lifelong Skills Grants.

Families and security
- Free school meals for all children in poverty; overhaul parental leave/pay (double statutory rates; new use-it-or-lose-it month for fathers/partners; day-one rights incl. self-employed); return to Erasmus+.
- Safety net: scrap two-child limit and benefit cap; target to end deep poverty in a decade; UC wait cut to 5 days; scrap bedroom tax; protect triple lock; fair settlement for WASPI women; raise and widen Carer’s Allowance.

Environment, food and farming
- End sewage scandal: tougher regulator replacing Ofwat; transform water firms into public benefit companies; ban bonuses until discharges end; legally binding targets; Clean Air Act; 60m trees/year; strong watchdogs.
- Food/farming: National Food Strategy; accelerate and fund Environmental Land Management (+£1bn/yr); uphold standards in trade; EU veterinary/plant health deals; stronger Groceries Code Adjudicator; high animal welfare; alt-proteins R&I fund.

Housing, transport, communities
- 380,000 homes/year including 150,000 social; 10 new garden cities; ban no-fault evictions; 3-year default tenancies; landlord register; abolish leasehold and cap ground rents; end rough sleeping; remove cladding at no cost to leaseholders; rent-to-own.
- Transport: restore 2030 zero-emission sales target; mass EV charging rollout and cheaper public charging VAT; freeze rail fares and simplify tickets; electrify rail; strengthen buses via franchising and £2 cap while reviewed; national active travel plan; pothole funding; curb short domestic flights; airport expansion moratorium.
- Local government: multi-year funding; powers over second homes/short lets; universal gigabit broadband; oppose imposed mayors.

Crime, rights, immigration, international
- Policing and justice: visible community policing; guarantee police attendance for burglaries; Online Crime Agency; court backlog plan; strong domestic abuse support; rehab and resettlement focus.
- Rights and democracy: defend HRA/ECHR; PR (STV) for MPs and English councils; scrap voter ID; votes at 16; cap party donations; Ministerial Code in law; citizens’ assemblies; Digital Bill of Rights; ban conversion practices; modern trans recognition; disability inclusion.
- Immigration/asylum: end Hostile Environment; scrap Illegal Migration Act/Rwanda; 3‑month asylum decision standard and right to work after 3 months; safe legal routes; fair, flexible work visas; reverse family visa threshold rise; protect EU citizens; implement Windrush review.
- Defence/foreign: raise defence spending towards 2.5% GDP; reverse Army cuts; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls; rebuild EU ties via stepwise roadmap toward Single Market and long-term EU membership goal; restore 0.7% aid; robust support for Ukraine (including seizing Russian assets); call for immediate Israel–Gaza ceasefire and two-state solution; recognise Palestine; stand up to China/Russia; fund BBC World Service.
